name: customer_id
description: Unique customer identifier, e.g. C000123. Joins to bookings, web_sessions, customer_features and customer_month_status.

name: signup_date
description: Date the customer created their account.

name: home_market
description: Home metro area, e.g. Chicago, Toronto, Miami. Joins to plan.market and ad_performance.market.

name: home_market_climate
description: Climate group of the home market: cold (Chicago, Boston, Minneapolis, Detroit, Denver, Toronto, Cleveland, Milwaukee), warm (Miami, Phoenix, Houston, Los Angeles, San Diego) or mild (every other metro). Warm escapes sell mainly to cold-weather markets.

name: loyalty_tier
description: Cymbal Compass tier: none (not enrolled), blue, silver or gold. Anyone with a tier other than none is a Compass member.

name: loyalty_status
description: As of Sep 15, 2026: active (booked in the last 12 months), lapsed (booked at least once ever but not in the last 12 months) or never (no confirmed booking on record).

name: last_booking_date
description: Date of the most recent confirmed booking, including bookings before the data window. NULL when the customer has never booked.

name: lifetime_bookings
description: Count of confirmed bookings over the customer's lifetime, including bookings before Jul 1, 2025.

name: lifetime_value_usd
description: Total confirmed booking revenue over the customer's lifetime, in US dollars.

name: email_optin
description: TRUE when the customer has opted in to marketing email.

name: sms_optin
description: TRUE when the customer has opted in to marketing SMS.
